home.bio: Hello, World! I'm a Software Developer turning ideas into reliable, scalable applications — from clean React interfaces to solid Node.js and PostgreSQL backends, with a focus on clean code and great UX.

skills.title: Technical Expertise
skills.description1: I build robust software that scales — combining clean code, end-to-end type safety and AI-assisted workflows, always with the end user in mind.
skills.description2: An overview of the technologies, frameworks and tools I use to ship end-to-end products.

fullstack.title: Full-Stack Software Engineering
fullstack.description: End-to-end solutions — clean React/Next.js frontends paired with scalable Node.js / ASP.NET Core APIs.

database.title: Database Systems & Data Modeling
database.description: Relational and NoSQL modeling with focus on integrity, indexing and ORM integration (Drizzle, EF Core, Prisma).

architecture.title: Software Architecture
architecture.description: SOLID, maintainability and performance first — building systems that are easy to evolve and scale.

testing.title: Automated Testing
testing.description: Unit, integration and E2E coverage with Vitest, xUnit and Playwright to keep quality and confidence high.

uiux.title: UI/UX Design & Styling
uiux.description: Functional, accessible interfaces with Tailwind CSS and shadcn/ui — modern, fast and consistent.

ai.title: AI-Assisted Development
ai.description: Using AI (ChatGPT, Gemini, OpenCode) to accelerate coding, testing and documentation without compromising quality.

projects.title: Featured Projects
projects.subtitle: A selection of recent builds — real problems, shipped solutions.

habitTrack.description: Habit tracker with daily check-ins, streak stats and local persistence — built with React 19, TypeScript and Tailwind for a fast, offline-first UX.

quintoSet.description: Full platform for Quinto Set volleyball school (Cesarão): free enrollment, lead management and secure admin panel with 15-min inactivity lock — Next.js 15 + PostgreSQL + Drizzle.

vaultEngine.description: A robust API for data control and authentication.

cloneReserva.description: Responsive e-commerce storefront clone — layout replication, interactive components and dynamic catalog with clean, mobile-first UX.

overmatch.description: Institutional landing for an English academy — course previews, modern layout and optimized performance for conversion.
